title: Naturality of representative-normalized tensor-Hom evaluation
statement: Let X be any scheme, R any sheaf of commutative rings on its pro-etale site, and a a normalized TensorPresentation [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models]. For all derived R-module objects K, K′, W and every f:K′→K, tensoring the Hom precomposition map Hom(f,W) with the identity of K′ and then evaluating at K′ equals tensoring f with the identity of Hom(K,W) and then evaluating at K. There is no boundedness, finiteness, geometric, or reduction assumption.

source.place: Lemma 08J9 (lemma-internal-hom), functorial Hom-total-tensor currying, with K-flat resolutions 06YS/06YU.

proof.text: Apply the closed symmetric monoidal theorem to R. Full faithfulness at the product of K-flat localizations lifts the ratio of its tensor comparison and a.representative to a natural tensor isomorphism. Transport the closed adjunction by this isomorphism and Koszul symmetry to the tensor order K tensor Hom(K,W).

Represent K by K-flat P and W by K-injective I. For every K-flat S and q:S→Hom(P,I), the inverse transpose of the transported adjunction sends x tensor z in bidegree (i,j) to (-1)^(ij)q(z)(x), by its uncurry_model and symmetry_model. The evaluation field of a gives exactly the same formula. Direct-sum inclusions, sheafification adjunction and pure tensors detect equality of the chain maps. Hom(P,I) is K-injective; hence all derived maps to it have chain representatives modulo homotopy. K-flat resolutions of arbitrary sources and K-injective representatives of targets extend equality to every inverse transpose, and therefore to the counits.

Use evaluation_naturality of the closed structure. Naturality of the tensor isomorphism and the braiding transports this identity to a.tensor. Substitute the equality of the transported and original counits from the preceding step.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 08J9: make explicit its functoriality for the separately supplied normalized presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem evaluation_naturality (X : Scheme.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (a : TensorPresentation.{u, u} X R)
    (K K' W : Derived.{u, u} X R) (f : K' ⟶ K) :
    a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
      ((hom.{u, u} X R).map (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫
        (a.adjunction K').counit.app W =
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ (a.adjunction K).counit.app W
